_story: Demo 3 — a customer shows a merchant a ₹12,000 'payment successful' screenshot that never settled. Synthetic data only.

expected_response.recommended_action: Hold the goods for now. Check your settlement list in your merchant app, or ask the customer to pay again while you watch for the credit.
expected_response.explanation: No ₹12,000 credit with transaction ID 428913570012 appears in your ledger. The screenshot's timestamp is 3 minutes after the time it was shown, and the amount text uses a different font from the rest of the receipt — both are signs the image may have been edited.
